title: frametrail:attributes of type "html"
description: Custom HTML overlay or annotation, for what the other types cannot show. Not sanitised. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items whose type is "html". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

text.description: The HTML source. HTML, stored HTML-escaped ("<p>Hello</p>"); FrameTrail unescapes it before rendering.
